name: agentkit
description: Repo-local maintainability workflow for agent-led coding tasks.

interface.shortDescription: Keep agent-led code changes tied to durable intent, checks, review, and closeout.
interface.longDescription: AgentKit teaches coding agents how to start tasks, read durable intent, run repository checks, request review, and close or block work traceably.
defaultPrompt: Use AgentKit to start this task and follow the repository closeout workflow.
Use AgentKit to check whether this task is ready for review and closeout.
